description:
FILED s531b (Opus, 2026-11-01), found by the board's new perl ORACLE (a MISMATCH line: two blessed PERL-SKIP rows on files perl RUNS on this box).

IO-Compress-2.214-0 t/999pod.t and Text-CSV-2.04 t/00_pod.t both do `eval "use Test::Pod 1.00"; plan skip_all => "Test::Pod 1.00 required for testing POD" if $@;`.  Test::Pod 1.52 is installed in the box perl's site_perl, so perl RUNS the files (31 rows / 2 rows, all ok); PCL prints the skip line, so both files read FAIL under the SKIP rule (PCL skipping a file perl runs is a divergence).  Before s531b both rows were blessed PERL-SKIP ("Test::Pod ... not installed on this box") -- true when blessed, stale since the module arrived; the key could not see it, the oracle does.

REPRODUCER (scratch/s531b/p-testpod.pl):
  eval "use Test::Pod 1.00";
  print $@ ? "FAIL: " . substr($@, 0, 300) . "\n" : "loaded Test::Pod $Test::Pod::VERSION\n";
perl 5.40.3: loaded Test::Pod 1.52
PCL (main ade297e7): FAIL: Can't locate object method "exported_to" via package "Test::Builder" at - line 1.

Test::Pod's import calls Test::Builder->exported_to (Test::Builder's API, used by every Test::Builder-based test module of the Test::Pod generation); PCL's Test::Builder (the TAP layer, cl/pcl-test.lisp + its shim) lacks it.  Probably a family: grep the other Test::Builder methods Test::Pod / Test::Pod::Coverage / Test::CPAN::Meta call (exported_to, plan, ok, diag, has_plan ...).  The board rows were re-caused to this task by s531b.
subject: Test::Pod (installed) does not load under PCL: Test::Builder->exported_to is missing -- two board files PCL skips and perl runs (IO-Compress 999pod.t, Text-CSV 00_pod.t)
